title: Upgrade migration/adoption engine to typed parity-proven v2
objective: Implement ADR-0002: upgrade envctl migration/adoption from audit/bootstrap into a typed, parity-proven meta layout engine. Envctl must scan/classify/plan/adopt/verify/activate/quarantine/purge component-scoped migrations into $META_ROOT system-shaped paths (.local/bin, .local/lib, .local/share, .local/state, .local/cache, .local/tmp, component toolchain roots) without manual path surgery, downgrades, or blind deletion. Broad migration/purge remains blocked until this task's v2 planner, evidence ledger, verification gates, activation proof, protected-path rules, and CI no-new-debt ratchet are implemented.
acceptance_criteria: ADR-0002, the TASK-0078 design/spec, the task card, and the backlog entry are committed under .handoff.
The migration planner emits typed component ownership, canonical meta paths, adoption method, verifier, risk, and purge policy for every migration candidate.
Unknown and protected candidates are read-only findings and cannot be moved, rewritten, quarantined, or purged.
Evidence ledger v2 records before/after identity, checksums where meaningful, path resolution, verifier commands/results, activation changes, rollback/quarantine data, and purge eligibility.
All mutating migration commands are dry-run by default and require --apply; mutating apply is component-scoped or explicitly grouped.
Activation proves meta-owned paths resolve first through envctl env/dashboard surfaces before any legacy path is eligible for quarantine.
Purge is refused until canonical parity and a second verification pass succeed; protected surfaces such as loop_lib, .handoff, .kb, Codex/agent assets, and secrets state are preserve-only by default.
A CI no-new-debt gate prevents new hardcoded user-global/system-global install targets unless covered by a typed adoption rule or host-prereq exception.
No downgrade is introduced; if a canonical candidate is older or less capable than legacy, the migration fails and requires an upgrade plan.
